answer_1.quote: We propose the problem of long-term constrained dialogue generation... our goal is to generate a given set of control words in the responses of one of the speakers (agent or customer).
answer_1.outputs: Generated system (or agent) responses containing the specified control words

answer_2.quote: We propose a new set of metrics: long‑term success rate, and precision, recall, and F1‑score for control words. We also report fluency (perplexity) and success rate.

answer_4.quote: We follow recent work on good evaluation practices for text generation approaches... Two raters annotated each example, and agreement was measured using Krippendorff's alpha for each of the 5 metrics. We evaluate each conversation on fluency, consistency of control word generation, relevance, coherence, and diversity.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each conversation on five criteria: fluency, control‑consistency, relevance, coherence, and diversity.
